goal: Persist SDK messages per-message via a new append_sdk_message store verb wired through the invoker on_message seam, replacing the per-iteration batch write.

references: src/flywheel/harness.py:411-435 — _persist_sdk_messages (the batch save_sdk_messages call to remove) and _serialize_sdk_message
src/flywheel/harness.py ~1635 — _drive_iterations emit site; wire the per-message persistence closure through InvocationRequest.on_message
src/flywheel/invoker.py:140, 194-199 — invoke_iteration and the best-effort on_message seam
src/flywheel/store_sqlite.py — _next_run_sequence and save_sdk_messages; factor the per-row body into append_sdk_message
constraints: Keep save_sdk_messages in the protocol and every implementation for backward compatibility; the harness simply stops calling it.
Add no new event kind: the per-message sdk_messages rows are themselves the progress signal.
append_sdk_message allocates one sequence tick from the shared per-run counter (mirror of append_event), inserts, and calls notifier.notify.

Preserve capture-then-re-raise audit-failure semantics: a per-message write failure is captured into nonlocal first_audit_error and re-raised after the invoker returns, re-entering the existing _AuditWriteError -> _handle_audit_failure -> harness.audit_write_failed -> INTERNAL_ERROR path; never abort the agent run mid-stream.
Compose the persistence observer with the existing stdout renderer in the production invoker (do not replace it); each callback is independently try/except-isolated.
Purity of flywheel.task, flywheel.lifecycle, and events.apply is untouched; no DomainEventKind change.
CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION is unchanged; no schema migration.
Update the harness test stub _AuditFailureStore and the save-sdk-messages-failure test to the new append_sdk_message write path.
Run mcp__ide__getDiagnostics on every .py file touched and fix all Pylance errors before reporting done.
Commit with a Conventional Commits feat: message before emitting intent=verify.
non_goals: No observer/CLI rewrite: rendering lifecycle position, running tokens/cost, and latest tool call in live / the heartbeat is feature 00011; existing observers consume the data unchanged.
No schema migration; sdk_messages already carries attempt_number, iteration_number, and sequence per row.
No interactivity: no interrupt, inject, steer, or persistent ClaudeSDKClient.
Do not remove save_sdk_messages; it stays in the protocol and all implementations.
edge_cases: Iteration produces zero messages: no appends; harness.iteration_completed still emitted; behavior identical to today.
Crash mid-iteration: messages persisted up to the crash remain in the store (no batch atomicity was ever relied upon).
Concurrent workers writing to one store: unchanged; _next_run_sequence is atomic and per-run, so per-message appends serialize like batch writes did.
